items.title: Gold Just Sank to a One-Year Low. Costco Members Who Bought Bars in September Are Down About $700 Each, and Launch Buyers Are Still Up 88%
items.summary: Gold fell to its lowest in more than a year on Wednesday. Costco has sold one-ounce gold bars to members since 2023, non-refundable and with no buyback, and a member who bought at every wave is up $6,002.16 on eight bars overall and down $1,469.46 on the two bought in September. Here is each lot at today's price, the premium, the rebate, the 28% collectibles tax, and what a member should know when gold drops.
